parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/AppServices/Tests/AppServicesTests/ReviewRequestServiceTests.swift`. The restraint rule is unambiguous: any cluster where a participating record is a test fixture must be recommended as no-action. Although the Jaccard similarity of 0.8181 suggests structural overlap between `shouldRequestReviewAtThreshold` (line 90) and `actionsAfterReviewDoNotRetrigger` (line 177), these are distinct test scenarios for the `ReviewRequestService` — one verifying threshold-triggered review requests and the other verifying that post-review actions do not re-trigger the flow. Collapsing them into a generic helper would obscure test intent and couple unrelated assertions, which is the canonical reason test fixtures are excluded from generic-parameterization refactors.
